01 — Who we are

Helping brands make a lasting impression.

Impressions Media is a creative media and digital communication brand. Founded in 2023, it began when two people came together with one aim: to solve the communication, branding and creative challenges that businesses and organisations face.

We believe effective creativity should do more than look good. It should help a brand present itself professionally, communicate its value and connect with its audience. Whether we work with a school, a restaurant or a growing business, we focus on solutions that reflect the client’s identity, objectives and audience.

Our mission

To help businesses and organisations communicate their value and build recognisable brands through creative, effective and purposeful media solutions.

Our vision

To become a trusted creative media partner for businesses and organisations seeking quality visual communication, compelling digital content and consistent brand presentation.

Four services. One creative partner.

01

Social Media Management

  • Strategy and content planning
  • Content crafting and calendars
  • Social media graphics
  • Scheduling and publishing
  • Page management: Instagram, Facebook, X
  • Performance monitoring
02

Video Creation & Editing

  • Promotional and advertising videos
  • Short-form videos and Reels
  • Branded video with text, motion and music
  • Editing of footage you supply
  • Adapting video for each platform
03

Brand Identity Design

  • Logo design and refinement
  • Colours and typography
  • Brand guidelines
  • Stationery and branded materials
  • Brand refresh and rebranding
04

Graphic Design

  • Flyers, posters and banners
  • Menus, brochures and company profiles
  • Campaign and event creatives
  • Digital and print-ready designs

A note on video: we create and edit video. On-location filming is not part of our current services, so you shoot the footage and send it to us to edit to your brief.

03 — Our approach

Understand first. Then create.

  1. 1

    Discovery & consultation

    We learn about your brand, audience, objectives, current challenges and expectations.

  2. 2

    Planning & direction

    We shape the creative approach, project scope, content plan or campaign direction.

  3. 3

    Creative development

    We create the agreed work: design, video, editing, content or social media management.

  4. 4

    Review & refinement

    We share the work for feedback and revise it within the agreed scope.

  5. 5

    Delivery & ongoing support

    We deliver approved work, or continue supporting you under the agreed engagement.
